claims: Original creator says Manus helped him post every day and get millions of views

A minute later Manus 'researched the entire internet, including Instagram and TikTok' and generated a comprehensive playbook with executive summary, methodology, profile snapshots, 5+ winning patterns, hook formula library, recommended video structures
Manus can also browse/research and run agents that take action
how_to_steps: Paste the prompt (on-screen): 'You are a senior content strategist and viral video researcher. Reverse engineer the top 50 Instagram Reels in my niche...' with NICHE and MY POSITIONING filled in
Step 1 'Source the 50': search Instagram last 90 days via hashtags, caption keywords, explore page, mid-tier creators; cap 3 videos per creator, no duplicate concepts
Step 2 'Annotate every video': exact opening line (first 3 s), full transcript, visual structure, on-screen text cards with timing, caption, hashtags, audio, cuts in first 3 s, total cuts, CTA
Step 3 'Pattern analysis': hook patterns, 25-template hook bank, structure templates, caption formulae, hashtag matrix, audio, length/pacing (top 10 vs bottom 10), what NOT to do
Step 4 'The playbook': one Google Doc '[NICHE] Viral Reels Playbook — [DATE]' with executive summary etc.; deliverables Google Doc link, Markdown backup, CSV of the 50; rules: cite, don't guess
Review the output: executive summary, quantitative snapshot, winning content patterns, hook formula library, recommended structures
on_screen_only: manus logo; banner 'This AI will make you go viral and grow your social media'
Instagram Views 3,527,049 (Last 30 days, Apr 4 – May 3); Followers 10.7% / Non-followers 89.3%; Accounts reached 1,922,973 +241.7%
Manus home 'What can I do for you?' with pasted_content.txt attached

Output doc: 'Viral Short-Form Video Playbook for AI Productivity and Business Tools — Prepared by: Manus AI — Date: May 4, 2026'; sections Executive Summary, 'Quantitative Snapshot of the Public Sample' (TikTok directly observed vs Instagram directly observed), 'Winning Content Patterns — Pattern 1: Lead with an entrepreneur identity, not a generic AI claim', 'Hook Formula Library' table (archetypes like Reframe, Ranked stack, Tool-to-task map, Workflow proof, Before/after, Anti-hype), 'Recommended video structures'
Names appearing in output: Dan Martell, Sabrina Ramonov, Codie Sanchez

relevance.why: Marketing-content research, not building; sponsored and the 'researched the entire internet in a minute' claim is hype. The prompt structure itself is reusable with Claude for market/competitor research.

implement_score.why: Do not buy Manus for this; if content marketing is on the roadmap, run the same 4-step prompt in Claude with web search once and keep the hook bank.
